src:
MOV     DX, OFFSET ASKM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 48h          ; DOS: allocate BX paragraphs
MOV     BX, 1000h        ; 1000h x 16 bytes = 64 KB
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; error 8: we own all the memory
MOV     DX, OFFSET SHRINKM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Ah          ; DOS: resize the block at ES, our PSP
MOV     BX, 1000h        ; keep 64 KB: code, data and stack
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok
MOV     DX, OFFSET ASKM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 48h          ; and ask again
MOV     BX, 1000h
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok: AX = the block's segment
JC      DONE1
MOV     BLOCK1, AX
DEC     AX               ; its MCB is the paragraph below
MOV     ES, AX
XOR     DI, DI
MOV     DX, OFFSET OWNERM1
MOV     AX, CS
CMP     ES:[DI+1], AX    ; the owner: our PSP?
JE      SAY1
MOV     DX, OFFSET OTHERM1
SAY1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     DX, OFFSET SIZEM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, ES:[DI+3]    ; the size, in paragraphs
CALL    PHEX
MOV     DX, OFFSET PARASM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     ES, BLOCK1       ; ES = the block
MOV     DX, OFFSET FREEM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 49h          ; DOS: free the block at ES
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok
PUSH    CS               ; ES = our PSP again
POP     ES
DONE1:

ASKM1   DB      "allocate 64 KB: $"
SHRINKM1 DB     "shrink to 64 KB: $"
OWNERM1 DB      "owner = our PSP$"
OTHERM1 DB      "owner = someone else$"
SIZEM1  DB      ", size = $"
PARASM1 DB      "h paragraphs", 13, 10, "$"
FREEM1  DB      "free it: $"
BLOCK1  DW      0
RESULT  PROC    NEAR     ; print "ok", or "error" and AX when CF = 1
PUSHF                    ; keeps AX and CF for the caller
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET OKMSG
JNC     RESULT1
MOV     DX, OFFSET ERRMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
PUSH    AX
CALL    PDEC             ; the error code
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
RESULT1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
POPF
RET
RESULT  ENDP
OKMSG   DB      "ok", 13, 10, "$"
ERRMSG  DB      "error $"
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; digits on the stack
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
RET
PDEC    ENDP
PHEX    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX as four hex digits (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     CX, 4
PHEX1:
PUSH    CX
MOV     CL, 4
ROL     BX, CL           ; the top digit to the bottom
POP     CX
MOV     DL, BL
AND     DL, 0Fh
ADD     DL, "0"
CMP     DL, "9"
JBE     PHEX2
ADD     DL, 7            ; "A" to "F"
PHEX2:
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PHEX1
RET
PHEX    ENDP
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
